content.rendered: Here is the 2023-2024 Middleton Supply List for the upcoming school year. We will have a meet and greet on Monday, August 28th; drop in anytime between 4:00-6:00. At this time you are welcome to bring in your supplies and meet your new teacher for the year. If you purchased you school supplies through EPI those supplies will be in your classroom.
